runtime_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
cd /app/dependencies && go mod download && go mod verify
cd /app/dependencies && GOCACHE=/tmp/relai-go-build GOMAXPROCS=1 GOGC=50 go build -p=1 github.com/openai/openai-go/v3 github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go
probe_commands: cd /workspace && GOCACHE=/tmp/relai-go-build GOMODCACHE=/go/pkg/mod GOPROXY=off GOMAXPROCS=1 GOGC=50 go run -p=1 -mod=readonly /app/import_probe.go
